user.title: Add a mail account
user.description: Home Assistant will fetch and send the mail for this account. Your phone only shows it.

account.title: Account details
account.description: Enter the address and password of your mail account. Your provider's help pages list the IMAP and SMTP servers.

account_app.title: Account details
account_app.description:
This provider no longer accepts your normal password in other apps; it needs a one-time app password. It takes a minute:

1. [Turn on 2-Step Verification]({step1}) (a confirmation on your phone is enough).
2. [Create an app password]({step2}), name it 'Home Assistant' and copy it.
3. Paste it below. Spaces are fine.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in again
reauth_confirm.description: The mail server refused the password for {email}. Enter a new (app) password.

reconfigure.title: Change account
reconfigure.description: Change the servers or the password of {email}. Leave the password empty to keep the current one. The login is tested before saving.

error.invalid_auth_imap: Login failed (IMAP): check the address and password.
error.app_password_required: The provider refused your normal password: an app password is required. Follow steps 1 and 2 above, then paste the app password.
error.invalid_auth_smtp: Login failed for sending (SMTP): check the password.

data.name: Description
data.users: Users who may use this account

data_description.name: How this account is called in the app, e.g. 'Work'.
data_description.sender_name: Your name as recipients see it.
data_description.signature: The closing added below your messages, e.g. 'Kind regards, Alex'.
data_description.sent_folder: Leave empty to detect it automatically (Gmail keeps a copy itself).
data_description.users: Leave empty to allow all administrators.
data_description.push: Keeps one connection open so new mail arrives at once; the regular check then runs every 15 minutes.

shared_with_admins.title: Every administrator can read {account}
shared_with_admins.description: Nobody is chosen under *Users who may use this account* for the mail account {account}, so every Home Assistant administrator can read it and gets its notifications. Choose the users in the account options, or in the account screen of the Home-mail app.

idle_failing.title: Instant new mail does not work for {account}
idle_failing.description: Home-mail could not keep the IMAP IDLE connection for {account} open ({error}). It keeps checking for new mail regularly, so nothing is lost, only slower. If this stays, turn off *Instant new mail* in the account options.
